entries.proposition: CAPSID EXPOSURE ALONE IS NOT SUFFICIENT FOR THE ORGAN TOXICITY OF CONCERN: AT A COMPARABLE CAPSID DOSE, NEITHER EMPTY CAPSID NOR A GENOME WITHOUT A WORKING PROMOTER PRODUCED LIVER OR DORSAL ROOT GANGLION TOXICITY. THIS IS THE CLEANEST SEPARATION OF DOSE-DRIVEN FROM EXPRESSION-DRIVEN INJURY IN THE WAVE.
entries.snippet: Hepatic and DRG toxicities were only detected after administration of full AAV9 viral particles, but not empty capsids or Promoterless test articles.

entries.proposition: A BLOOD-MEASURABLE MARKER TRACKED THE DORSAL ROOT GANGLION LESION, BUT IT IS REPORTED HERE AS A RESTATEMENT OF THE AUTHORS' PRIOR STUDY AND IS NOT MEASURED IN THIS PAPER.
entries.snippet: Single-cell necrosis and neuroinflammatory changes were also observed in DRGs, which correlated with elevated levels of NfL that peaked on day 28.

entries.proposition: THE MAGNITUDE OF TRANSGENE EXPRESSION DOES NOT PREDICT WHICH TISSUE IS INJURED, WHICH IS IN TENSION WITH ATTRIBUTING DORSAL ROOT GANGLION TOXICITY TO SUPRAPHYSIOLOGICAL EXPRESSION LEVEL.
entries.snippet: This discrepancy between vector genome biodistribution and transgene transcript level suggests that while both the capsid and an active payload are necessary to cause tissue pathology (liver and DRGs), the amount of transgene product itself is not directly predictive of the observed toxicities (even when expressing a foreign protein such as GFP).
entries.anchor: Results, 'In-life summary and organ toxicities', closing sentence

entries.proposition: THE MODIFIABLE IMMUNE AXIS IDENTIFIED HERE SIGNALS THROUGH JAK/STAT RATHER THAN NF-KAPPA-B, WHICH THE AUTHORS OFFER AS A REASON GLUCOCORTICOIDS MAY BE INSUFFICIENT PROPHYLAXIS.
entries.snippet: This could provide some explanation as to why glucocorticoids are not always as potent as expected in preventing AAV-driven toxicity.

entries.proposition: THE ANIMALS RECEIVED NO IMMUNOSUPPRESSION, SO THE CLAIM THAT THE IMMUNE COMPONENT IS MODIFIABLE IS INFERENCE AND NOT MEASUREMENT IN THIS STUDY.
entries.snippet: However, it is important to note that unlike patients who receive glucocorticoids, which are potent nuclear factor (NF)-κB inhibitors, no immunosuppressive regimen was provided to animals included in studies A or B.

entries.proposition: THE RESPONSE IS STILL PRESENT FOUR WEEKS AFTER A SINGLE DOSE, SO THE RELEVANT SAFETY WINDOW IS NOT CONFINED TO THE PERI-PROCEDURAL PERIOD.
entries.snippet: In summary, our work revealed a low-grade but long-lasting immunological response in known organs primarily targeted by AAV9.

entries.proposition: THE COHORT IS FEMALE-ONLY AND WAS PRE-SELECTED FOR THE LOWEST ANTI-CAPSID TITRES, WHICH IS THE EXACT COMPLEMENT OF THE SEROPOSITIVE-STRATIFIED STUDY IN THIS WAVE AND FORBIDS POOLING THE TWO.
entries.snippet: Animals with the lowest titers were included in the study.
